Moderne Tischleuchte – Design im Stil des Space Age

Modern Glow – Space Age Table Lamp

 

Description:

Inspired by the unmistakable Space Age aesthetic of the 1960s, Modern Glow is a table lamp that blends retro charm with minimalist elegance. Its tilted, compact silhouette recalls the organic, futuristic forms of an era when space exploration shaped design and imagination.

 

With its sleek body and opaline front disc, this lamp is not just a light source—it’s a statement piece, perfect for enhancing modern, refined interiors.

 

Lighting compatibility:

The interior is precisely designed to fit the Maker Supply LED USB Kit-001, allowing you to effortlessly add warm, ambient lighting with no modifications needed.

 

Recommended printing materials:

• Body: best printed in PLA-CF (carbon fiber) to achieve a matte, professional finish that highlights its smooth lines and technical feel.

• Diffuser: print in basic white PLA to mimic frosted glass and ensure soft, uniform light diffusion.

 

Technical notes:

The model is optimized for support-free printing, ensuring clean results even on standard consumer-grade 3D printers.
Clorfullamps are printed in ABS and finished using acetone vapor post-processing to achieve a smooth, glossy surface.

Full printing and finishing instructions are available on our MakerWorld profile.

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#000000), PLA (#FFFFFF)
